# Virtual Sex Dice

> A free, browser-based 3D sex dice game for couples. Five customizable dice roll in a realistic 3D scene; the face that lands up on each die forms a prompt sentence (action, body part, duration, intensity, position, mood). No signup, no tracking, works on any device with a modern browser.

## What it is
Virtual Sex Dice is a web app — not a native app or a physical product. It runs entirely in the browser using WebGL. The dice are rendered with Three.js and obey a hand-rolled physics model (gravity, floor bounce, dice-to-dice collision).

## Who it's for
Couples looking for a private, low-effort bedroom activity. Works equally well for solo play and long-distance partners (screen-share the roll).

## Key features
- **3D physics**: dice actually tumble and settle — not a random-number animation
- **Customizable faces**: pick which prompt categories each die shows (action, body part, duration, intensity, position, mood)
- **No signup, no account**: the game is free and anonymous
- **Works offline after first load**: the app is a static site
- **Multi-device**: designed for mobile and desktop; touch and mouse both work

## Primary URL
- https://virtualsexdice.com/ — the game itself (the home page is the product)

## What this site is not
- Not a physical dice product (no shipping, no purchase)
- Not an adult video or image site
- Not a chat, match, or dating service
- No user accounts, no data collection beyond anonymous usage analytics
